_note: The quota arithmetic is the lab: four Pods on the namespace LimitRange defaults fill the medium budget's limit side exactly, then the oversized manifest is refused at admission. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag. The readiness-break steps need ~20s each to roll out and start failing, so their checks poll.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment-base.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc apply -f service.yaml && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s
oc scale deploy/hello-dcs --replicas=4 && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s
envsubst < deployment-probes.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=240s
envsubst < deployment-probes.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=240s
oc get pods -l app=hello-dcs -o name | head -n 1 > /tmp/deleted-pod.txt && oc delete "$(cat /tmp/deleted-pod.txt)"
